neet_che_u01_t03_1.working: 1 u is defined as 1/12 of the mass of a 12C atom, so one 12C atom has a mass of exactly 12 u. That 12 u equals about 1.99e-23 g, so option 3 is wrong. Option 4, 12 g, is the mass of one mole.

neet_che_u01_t03_3.working: Mass = 18 × 1.66e-24 g = 2.988e-23 g, which is about 2.99e-23 g.

neet_che_u01_t03_4.working: H2O = 18 u (III); NaCl = 58.5 u (IV); CO2 = 44 u (I); O3 = 48 u (II). This gives A-III, B-IV, C-I, D-II.

neet_che_u01_t03_5.working: A is correct: that is the definition of 1 u. B is correct: averages are abundance-weighted, so usually non-integral. C is false: NaCl is ionic with no discrete molecules, so 'formula mass' is the right term. D is correct: mass spectrometry gives isotopic masses and abundances. E is false: the weighted average is about 35.48 u, not the simple mean of 36.0 u. So A, B and D are correct.
